meta.title: Shudflow — AI product advisor for online shops
meta.description: AI product advisor for online shops outside Shopify: register, tune the bot, embed one widget.

hero.title: AI product advisor for online shops outside Shopify
hero.subtitle: A shop owner signs up, tunes the bot (tone, language, look), sees the price and embeds a single widget. Shoppers ask in their own language and get products from the shop's real catalog.
hero.context: CEE e-commerce · Prom.ua, Rozetka, custom sites · 2026

items.title: AI service
items.text: FastAPI, Claude, vector search over product embeddings; a fast or a stronger model is picked per question.

items.title: Answer checking
items.text: A recommended product must exist in the catalog. 10 of 10 test scenarios without invented products; 26 tests.
